_about: Polestar's own fixes to the merged reference data (data build applies them after QuestieDB, before recordings). One entry per fact, with where the fact comes from. quests: `set` replaces fields. npcs/objects: `set` replaces fields (Forever elite and rare ranks, which QuestieDB's Forever store lacks); `addSpawns` adds { "<uiMapID>": { f, pts } } maps the entity lacks (an existing map is replaced). items: `removeDrops` { npc: [ids], object: [ids] } and `removeVendors` [ids] drop wrong sources the pfQuest/QuestieDB union kept. Documented in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Reference data, Sources and precedence).
